name: fold-pr-into-issue
why: Fold 2: a PR that resolves a still-open ticket IS that ticket's concern, so it surfaces once as the issue row rather than as an issue and a PR. The issue row then carries the act the PR's own row would have offered - merge on a PASS - so nothing is lost by folding. PR #40 resolves nothing, so it keeps its own row: the fold is per concern, not a blanket suppression of pull requests.
